question: What is total payment volume by rail type for successful payments?
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY pa.rail_type ORDER BY tpv DESC
actual_sql:
SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv 
FROM payments p 
JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref 
WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' 
GROUP BY pa.rail_type 
ORDER BY tpv DESC

question: What is payment success rate for UPI payments since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE pa.rail_type = 'UPI' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.rail_type
actual_sql:
SELECT 
  pa.rail_type, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, 
  COUNT(*) AS attempts 
FROM payments p 
JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref 
WHERE pa.rail_type = 'UPI' 
  AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' 
GROUP BY pa.rail_type

question: Show monthly successful TPV by rail type from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-01.
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_time) AS month, pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND p.payment_time < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY month, pa.rail_type ORDER BY month, pa.rail_type
actual_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_time) AS month, pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv 
FROM payments p 
JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref 
WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND p.payment_time < '2026-06-01' 
GROUP BY month, pa.rail_type 
ORDER BY month, pa.rail_type
